limitations: Windows owns arbitrary application title bars and unsupported Win32 control foregrounds.
Command Palette custom tint cannot independently assign every foreground.
Lock-screen application requires a supported API and recoverable previous image; otherwise it is not applied.
Windows/Start updates outside the tested compatibility entry disable managed shell styling until reviewed.
Static cursor shapes preserve roles; host accessibility pointer overrides take priority.
